 PV-/PH-Series 
ESPEC temperature ovens 
 Home
 Products
 Environmental simulation
 Heating ovens
 PV-/PH-Series 
 Temperature ovens of the PV/PH series for particularly precise applications in the high-temperature range 
ESPEC offers its industrial ovens in two standard variants: The space-saving PV series industrial oven with a vertical design and the PH series with a horizontal orientation. Both models have a horizontal air flow for even loading of all test specimens. 
An external air connection ventilates the oven and allows rapid cooling. The standard version of the industrial ovens operates from a room temperature of +20 °C to +200 °C. Optionally, +300 °C is available. 
The heating or cooling phase can be easily controlled via the control element with two-stage programming. With an optional upgrade, users can also create up to 10 individual test programmes. The four-stage overheating protection offers safety. 
The ESPEC industrial ovens are available in numerous model variants and designs.
